scope: Complete 31/31 Hotspawn CS2 inventory and 31/31 HLTV match-page reconciliation (closing the 6 Oct 24 South American fixtures 2399912, 2399913, 2399817, 2399914, 2399818, 2399915), HLTV-first + EGamersWorld/multi-book consensus capture across all 13 model-only fixtures, and competition-scoped South American aliases in data/origination/aliases.json.
method: Fetched all 6 South American HLTV match pages (HTTP 200), the cache-busted Hotspawn CS2 lobby (/cs2-pickems?cb=1792823500) and Cloudways scheduled fixtures API (31 open fixtures), and EGamersWorld CS2 index/event/match pages first-hand. Reconciled all 31 active fixtures line by line against official sources; zero crowd percentages or fan votes were used.

items.area: Reviewed EGamersWorld bookmaker-average capture across the 13 model-only fixtures
items.finding: First-hand inspection of all 13 model-only fixtures on EGamersWorld identified 2 fixtures with verbatim EGWxxxBOT match-page quotes (1083122 LOS NINOS vs BORRACHEIROS 2.92 / 1.33 -> 28.08% / 71.92%; 1082858 Ground Zero vs Off Chops 3.44 / 1.24 -> 26.50% / 73.50%), 5 fixtures with two-sided index odds (1082996 2.42/1.50, 1079198 1.34/2.85, 1079200 1.44/2.50, 1082861 2.10/1.66, 1082792 1.09/6.80), and 6 fixtures with 1.80/1.80 template placeholders (1081152, 1081153, 1081154, 1081156, 1081158, 1082793).
items.handling: Recorded all 7 priced entries and 6 rejected 1.80/1.80 placeholders with SHA-256 excerpt hashes in data/research/c6b8d58b/reference-odds.json and verified zero schema/replay problems via scripts.reference_odds.

items.area: Crowd-poll exclusion: inverted HLTV fan votes on 1083121 and 1083123
items.finding: On HLTV 2399913 (1083121 Tropa do KinGui vs MEIA NOITE) and HLTV 2399915 (1083123 Grêmio vs Yawara), HLTV Pick-a-winner fan votes are 25%/75% and 75%/25% respectively — opposite to the real-money Thunderpick favorites Tropa do KinGui (1.49 / 2.53, 62.92%) and Yawara (3.05 / 1.35, 69.23%).
items.handling: Confirmed that neither Hotspawn "% picked" nor HLTV fan votes are ever used as probability inputs; both fixtures resolve strictly from real-money Thunderpick bookmaker lines.
